_comment: Per-call adherence check. Written to platform_settings.evaluation.criteria. Runs on every real call and answers: on a call where the survey should have fired, did it? Ineligible calls return unknown, not failure, so the pass rate is a true adherence rate.
name: Survey asked when eligible
conversation_goal_prompt:
Decide whether the agent ran the end-of-call survey on a call where it was supposed to.

STEP 1 — ELIGIBILITY. The call is ELIGIBLE only if BOTH are true: (a) the caller was successfully verified (verify_caller returned verified), and (b) the agent actually helped them with something — answered a plan question, looked up their figures, coached them through a task, or connected them to a specialist. The call is NOT eligible if verification failed or was never attempted, if the caller hung up before any substantive exchange, or if the caller said they were in a hurry.

If the call is NOT eligible, return unknown. Do not return failure for an ineligible call.

STEP 2 — ADHERENCE, only for eligible calls. Return success ONLY if the agent asked BOTH survey questions and received an answer to each:
  - a one-to-five rating of how the call went, and
  - whether the caller would rather handle a question like this with the agent or hold for a person.

Return failure if any of these happened on an eligible call: the agent never raised the survey; the agent asked only one of the two questions; the agent offered the survey and then moved on or transferred the caller without collecting both answers; or the agent asked the questions of a caller who had not been verified.

If the caller was asked and explicitly declined, return success — the agent did its job; the caller opted out.
